bug_semantics: An authenticated customer can submit an asynchronous cart-save request containing quote.orig_order_id. The async input resolver serializes that caller-controlled value and the queue consumer later invokes CartRepositoryInterface::save outside the webapi_rest area. In affected releases, ownership validation is registered only in webapi_rest, so the consumer persists the foreign original-order ID. When the quote is placed, QuoteManagement copies orig_order_id into Order::entity_id, allowing replacement of another customer's existing order. The fixed global plugin rejects an original order whose customer does not match the quote customer before any execution context saves the quote.
flaw_origin: Commit 78db7124ff1bed24a0f3687d83995fd01852364e is the atomic first-writer: its complete one-line patch made QuoteManagement set a placed order's entity ID from quote.orig_order_id while adding no authorization check. Immediate parent 3b69a9dbad3b102a43f8940da06e085a3bd80f79 lacks that sink. Later commit a90a0bdd48169fc1291e98f878116a3b651c15df only wrapped the already-existing assignment in a non-null check and is not the introducer.
